text: Boiling down the sour, lactic-acid-rich whey concentrates its acid and sugars until the mass darkens, and drying then leaves a black, brittle, very sour block.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The milk is put into the sour whey left from straining kashk.
The mix is boiled until it thickens.
The mix is left until it turns black and brittle, a very sour block.
